content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) Fortran source of the FUNWAVE-TVD flux/interface-reconstruction module (25 program units; header comment L14 says 'FILE main.F' although the content is the fluxes module). Driver SUBROUTINE FLUXES (L63-126) dispatches on HIGH_ORDER(1:3): 'FOU' calls CONSTRUCTION_HO (4th order MUSCL with combined minmod+van Leer, comments L69-73), 'FMI' calls CONSTRUCTION_HO_minmod (noted unstable, L82), 'WEN' calls CONSTRUCTION_WENO, 'MLP' calls CONSTRUCTION_HO_MLP, else DelxyFun+CONSTRUCTION (2nd order); each branch then calls WAVE_SPEED; then FLUX_AT_INTERFACE_HLL if CONSTR(1:3)=='HLL' else FLUX_AT_INTERFACE (L118-122), then BOUNDARY_CONDITION (L124). FLUX_AT_INTERFACE (L137-148) averages left/right states (P=0.5*(PR+PL), etc.). FLUX_AT_INTERFACE_HLL (L159-170) applies HLL to the six flux/state pairs (P,Q,Fx,Fy,Gx,Gy). HLL(M,N,SL,SR,FL,FR,UL,UR,FOUT) (L180-203): FOUT=FL if SL>=0, FR if SR<=0, else (SR*FL-SL*FR+SL*SR*(UR-UL))/(SR-SL) with SMALL guard (L192-198). DelxyFun (L213-230) computes van-Leer-limited slopes of Eta,U,V,HU,HV via DelxFun/DelyFun. DelyFun (L240-270)/DelxFun (L280-309): interior van Leer limited slope (TMP1*|TMP2|+|TMP1|*TMP2)/(|TMP1|+|TMP2|) with zero when |TMP1|+|TMP2|<SMALL, one-sided at edges. WAVE_SPEED (L325-412, Zhou et al. 2001 approach; history L317-322 notes Steve Brandt ghost-cell remark and a Dmitry-case bug about M1/N1): x-interface SxL=MIN(UL-sqrt(g|HxL|),U_S-SQR_PHI_S), SxR=MAX(UR+sqrt(g|HxR|),U_S+SQR_PHI_S) with SQR_PHI_S=0.5*(SQR_PHI_L+SQR_PHI_R)+0.25*(UL-UR), U_S=0.5*(UL+UR)+SQR_PHI_L-SQR_PHI_R (L344-349), y likewise (L377-385), then ghost-cell edge copying (L354-374, L390-410). CONSTRUCTION (L425-560, 2nd order): allocates MASK9u/MASK9v extended masks (ykchoi 09.07.2015, L433-440), CONSTRUCT_X/CONSTRUCT_Y piecewise-linear reconstruction of U,V,HU,HV,Eta (L444-448,L503-507), HxL/R=EtaRxL/R+Depthx (L449-450), U4/V4 when DISPERSION (L452-460,L511-519 with ykchoi DelxV4/DelyU4 additions), then assembles interface fluxes: PL/PR=HUxL/R+Gamma1*MASK9u*HxL/R*U4xL/R (L466-471), FxL/R=Gamma3*PL/R*(UxL/R+Gamma1*MASK9u*U4xL/R)+0.5*GRAV*(EtaRx^2*Gamma3+2*EtaRx*Depthx) (L476-484), GxL/R=HxL/R*(UxL/R+Gamma1*...U4xL/R)*(VxL/R+Gamma1*...V4xL/R)*Gamma3 per Shi et al. 2012 (ykchoi, L488-498), and y-counterparts QL/QR,GyL/GyR,FyL/FyR (L522-556); deallocates masks (L558). CONSTRUCT_Y (L573-603)/CONSTRUCT_X (L616-643): piecewise linear OutL(I,J)=Vin(I,J-1)+0.5*DY*Din(I,J-1), OutR=Vin-0.5*D*Din with one-sided ends (kappa argument retained but meaningless per ykchoi comments L584-586); Jeff Harris limiter replacement 06/01/2011 and Choi kappa removal 08/31/2016 noted in history. CONSTRUCTION_HO_minmod (L659-779, Yamamoto et al. 1998): same flux assembly but reconstruction by CONSTRUCT_HO_X_minmod/CONSTRUCT_HO_Y_minmod (L793-892, L907-1007): 4th-order MUSCL where Din=TXP2-1/6*(DVP3-2*DVP2+DVP1) from three double-minmod-limited differences (L809-858) with dry-cell fallbacks (lower-order when MASK(I-2)/(I+1)==0 at L830-851; zero gradient when MASK(I-1)/(I)==0 at L852-856), then OutL=Vin(I-1,J)+1/6*(TXP1+2*TXP2), OutR=Vin(I,J)-1/6*(TXP3+2*TXP4) with 4*Din limiting (L862-891; comment L875 'there was a HUGE bug here, 12 should versus 43, fixed. fyshi'). REAL(SP) FUNCTION VANLEER_LIMITER(A,B) (L1020-1034): (A*|B|+|A|*B)/(|A|+|B|) or single-argument (A+|A|)/(1+A); FUNCTION MINMOD_LIMITER(A,B,C) (L1036-1050): SIGN(1,A)*MAX(0,MIN(|A|,SIGN(1,A)*B[,SIGN(1,A)*C])) — both by Gangfeng Ma/Shi (L1014-1015), neither called elsewhere in this file (inline expressions used instead). CONSTRUCTION_HO (L1064-1171, Erduran et al. 2005 hybrid FV-FD reference L1059-1060): same assembly with CONSTRUCT_HO_X/CONSTRUCT_HO_Y (L1178-1286, L1293-1401): 4th-order MUSCL-TVD where the minmod limiter builds Din (L1192-1248) and the van Leer ratio limiter VAN=(RAT+|RAT|)/(1+RAT) weights the 3rd-order part: OutL=Vin(I-1,J)+(1/6)*(VAN1*TMP1+2*VAN2*TMP2), OutR=Vin(I,J)-(1/6)*(2*VAN1*TMP1+VAN2*TMP2) (L1252-1281). CONSTRUCTION_HO_MLP (L1408-1515; same as CONSTRUCTION_HO but using CONSTRUCT_HO_X_MLP/CONSTRUCT_HO_Y_MLP per comments L1405-1406): MLP (multi-dimensional limiting process) reconstruction (L1520-1589 x, L1594-1664 y): slope ratios gamL=TXP2/TXP1, gamR=TXP2/TXP3, betaL/R=(1+2*gam)/3, transverse-gradient factors tanth1/tanth2, alphL/R=clamp(1..2) of alphLin/alphRin, slopeL=max(0,min(alphL*gamL,min(alphL,betaL))), OutL=Vin(I-1,J)+0.5*slopeL*Txp1 and mirrored OutR, with smallv=1e-10 guards. CONSTRUCTION_WENO (L1682-1781, ykchoi 08.14.2016; spherical option removed due to U4xL conflict, L1680): assembly with WENO_CONSTRUCT_X/WENO_CONSTRUCT_Y (L1794-1874, L1885-1965): fifth-order WENO for constant dx (references Qiu and Shu 2005; Shu 2009): three smoothness indicators WBETA0-2=13/12*TXP1^2+1/4*TXP2^2, unnormalized weights WjBAR=Rj/(WNEPS+WBETAj)^2 with right weights R0_R=3/10,R1_R=3/5,R2_R=1/10 and left weights R0_L=1/10,R1_L=3/5,R2_L=3/10, normalized WNWj, candidate stencil polynomials WNP0-2, and OutR/OutL=sum(WNWj*WNPj) (L1816-1869 x; L1907-1960 y).

verbatim_spans.text: !  Chois tests show this is unstable combination (4th + minmod), switched off 08/31/2016
!             There's a bug found in Dmitry's case. In x direction,
! there was a HUGE bug here, 12 should versus 43, fixed. fyshi
! 1. Runge-Kutta discontinuous Galerkin method using WENO limiters (Qiu and Shu, 2005)

unresolved: Header comment L14 says 'FILE main.F' while every subroutine here is the fluxes/reconstruction module — header/content mismatch (preprocessor concatenation artifact or copy-paste)

Loop indices I,J and temporaries TMP1,TMP2 (used at L1253,L1269 in CONSTRUCT_HO_X and L1368,L1384 in CONSTRUCT_HO_Y and in Del*Fun @L252-253,L292-293) are not declared locally — they come from PARAM/GLOBAL modules (cross-file); the same-named local TXP1/TYP1 sets shadow nothing but the mixed use of module-level TMP* inside these kernels means the routines are not thread-safe as written
VANLEER_LIMITER (L1020) and MINMOD_LIMITER (L1036) are defined but never called in this file; DelxFun/DelyFun/CONSTRUCT_HO_* inline the same expressions instead (commented-out calls @L259,L298)
CONSTRUCT_HO_X_MLP/Y_MLP ignore their MASK argument — no dry-cell fallback unlike the minmod/HO variants (declared @L1526/L1600 but never referenced in the body)
WENO_CONSTRUCT_X/Y have no MASK argument at all — CONSTRUCTION_WENO passes none (L1696-1700), so WENO reconstruction has no wetting-drying protection in this file
CONSTRUCT_X/CONSTRUCT_Y keep the Kappa dummy argument though ykchoi comments (L584-586, L627-628) state kappa is meaningless after the 08/31/2016 simplification

MLP x-variant reads Vin(I-1,J+1),Vin(I-1,J-1),Vin(I,J+1),Vin(I,J-1) (L1555-1560) — transverse stencil access with no J-bound guard at J=Jbeg-?; loop runs J=Jbeg,Jend (L1538) so J-1/J+1 stay within ghost region only if Nghost>=1 (cross-file assumption)
the six-argument declaration REAL(SP)::SR,SL,FL,FR,UL,UR in FLUX_AT_INTERFACE_HLL (L161) is unused — the actual SL/SR etc. are the GLOBAL arrays passed to HLL
BOUNDARY_CONDITION (L124), EXCHANGE-side arrays (PL,PR,QL,QR,FxL..GyR,UxL..V4yR,Depthx,Depthy,Kappa,HIGH_ORDER,CONSTR,Gamma1,Gamma3,MASK9) are defined in GLOBAL/other files (cross-file)
